summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a best-and-final non-binding proposal from Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and Founder/CEO Sumant Sinha to acquire all shares not already held by the Consortium for US$7.02 per share in cash. This represents a 12.5% premium to the May 28, 2026 close and a 24.7% premium to the one-month VWAP. The transaction would be structured as a UK scheme of arrangement; shareholders receive cash unless they elect to roll over their shares. The Special Committee, advised by Rothschild & Co and Linklaters, is evaluating the proposal. Watch for further updates from the Special Committee and potential competing bids.
